title: Goin' Coastal | KEY.co
description_expanded: Goin’ Coastal offers a refreshing blend of coastal charm and upscale comfort in the sought-after Magnolia Cottages neighborhood. With its professionally designed interiors, soaring ten-foot ceilings, and light-filled spaces, the home instantly soothes the senses. Guests are welcomed by a breezy screened-in porch perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails, and an open-concept living space featuring plush seating, a 50” Smart TV, and a chef’s kitchen with quartz countertops and premium appliances. Whether gathering around the custom dining banquette or enjoying time outdoors, this home invites connection and relaxation at every turn. Ideal for families and couples alike, the home comfortably accommodates up to seven guests, featuring two elegant king suites and a playful bunk room, each with a private en-suite bathroom. Children and pets are especially well cared for, with thoughtful touches like games, dog beds, and a fenced yard. Extras such as a six-seater street-legal golf cart, beach gear, and access to a heated community pool elevate every beach day. Perfectly situated between The Big Chill and Rosemary Beach, Goin’ Coastal is a luxurious retreat where every detail is designed for effortless vacation living.
